stories.title: Plant City murder-suicide highlights emotional toll on first responders, community
stories.summary: For the second time in six months, a murder-suicide involving young children has shaken the Plant City community, prompting calls for mental health support.

stories.title: State revokes Pasco midwife’s license after ‘egregious’ conduct
stories.summary: “It is impossible not to conclude that respondent poses a serious danger to the public and must be removed from this profession," an FLDOH final order reads.

stories.title: Plastic surgeon Dr. Tomasz Kosowski to be sentenced Friday | How to watch
stories.summary: Kosowski was convicted of killing attorney Steven Cozzi back in 2023. Cozzi's body has never been found.

stories.title: Thomas Markle found competent to proceed in federal child sexual abuse material case
stories.summary: The estranged father of Meghan Markle is scheduled for a Dec. 1 preliminary hearing in Tampa. His attorney says he continues to “vehemently” deny the allegations.

stories.title: Man killed his entire family in Plant City before taking his own life, sheriff says
stories.summary: Sheriff Chad Chronister described the 911 call, where a small child was begging for his life saying, "Daddy, please don't shoot me," before a loud bang went off.

stories.title: Busy Thanksgiving travel period underway at Tampa International Airport with nearly 1M passengers expected
stories.summary: The Thanksgiving travel period at TPA runs from Nov. 19 to Nov. 30.

stories.title: Tampa City Council advances charter changes that could shift power from mayor
stories.summary: Several proposals advanced, including an independent inspector general and more control over council staffing.

stories.title: Tampa Bay-area charities rally to meet Thanksgiving food needs
stories.summary: As rising costs continue to strain family budgets and local charities, food drives across Tampa Bay are stepping up to help those in need this Thanksgiving.

stories.title: Give the gift of joy this holiday season: Donate to the Angel Tree
stories.summary: Achieva Credit Union and 10 Tampa Bay News have partnered with The Salvation Army for its Angel Tree program.

stories.title: Polk County approves $20 million for I-4 flyover project to ease congestion on U.S. 27
stories.summary: A new I-4 flyover aims to ease U.S. 27 congestion, with Polk County committing up to $20 million toward the project.

stories.title: Video shows man fleeing from Polk County sergeant, crashing during pursuit
stories.summary: The suspect, Gabriel Jimenez, ran over Sergeant Brett Hermelbracht with his car before fleeing, officials say.

stories.title: St. Pete officer resigns after audit finds he used Flock cameras to look up woman
stories.summary: Officer Jonathan Reisz resigned from the St. Pete Police Department on Sept. 8. The woman declined to press charges.
